sources.entry: 7. Gigapixel AI - Upscaling images using AI.

summary.name: Topaz Gigapixel AI
summary.one_liner: Topaz Gigapixel AI is a commercial AI image upscaler that enlarges photos and images with deep-learning models while aiming to preserve or add detail.
keywords: make image bigger without losing quality
use_cases: Upscaling low-resolution photos for large prints
Cropping into images without losing quality
Restoring old or scanned black-and-white and color photos
Enlarging high-ISO or low-light wildlife shots
Preparing images for posters or billboards
Using as a plugin inside Photoshop or Lightroom Classic
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Topaz Gigapixel AI as an image upscaler that increases image size and detail using deep learning. It offers nine enhancement models (including Standard, High Fidelity, Low Res, Text & Shapes, Art & CG, Recover, Redefine, and Face Recovery, plus newer Wonder and Standard MAX upscale models) for different image types. It can run as a standalone desktop app or as a plugin for Photoshop and Lightroom Classic. Processing can be done locally, so files stay on the computer, or via cloud rendering, which the page says is unlimited on paid plans. The page claims up to 6x lossless zoom for cropping.
notable: Nine enhancement AI models for different image types
Available as standalone app or plugin for Photoshop and Lightroom Classic
Local and unlimited cloud rendering options
Page says it was the first commercially available AI image upscaler, since 2019
caveats: Paid subscription required; plans listed as annual or monthly at $149 billed annually and $499 billed annually tiers, with Topaz Studio bundles also offered
Commercial use free only for organizations under $1M USD annual revenue, per the page footnote
Mac and Windows only per the page; no Linux or mobile version of Gigapixel named
